dedupe_keys.name: identifying policy areas for the transition of the transportation sector

description: Karlo Hainsch at Technische Universität Berlin applies GENeSYS-MOD to policy choices for decarbonising German transport. The preprint abstract reports 400 sensitivities linking transport changes to the wider energy system. It compares modal shift, demand reduction, electrification and carbon prices. The reported findings favour less energy-intensive modes and avoided demand for reducing energy use, emissions and fleet size; carbon pricing has stronger effects after 2040. These are scenario-model findings, not observed effects of implemented policy. The separate companion dataset contains inputs, model files and sensitivity outputs and is linked as a resource used. Zenodo provides the preprint freely under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is Germany. The full scenario period, calibration details and uncertainty treatment are not stated in the abstract. Only native descriptive metadata was inspected; the PDF was not downloaded and the claimed outcomes were not independently reproduced.
